title: Roundup issues on the new records; convert sent issues on Shipped and Distinctive
description:
Replace ISSUE# and ROUNDUP#<listId>/PERIOD#<yyyy-ww> rows. A roundup Announcement announces the issue Story at its approved version, plus one email Delivery; approval and send time move to the Announcement, counts to the Delivery, resultUrl is the archive page. ROUNDUP period becomes the dedupeKey. ISSUE#/RENDER HTML and text move to S3. Sent issues on Shipped and Distinctive are converted once by a command, sends frozen for that window (as agreed for the Caducus move). The per-reader SEND# ledger is not part of this slice. Edited-after-approval returns to waiting for approval. Follows the Caducus move.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: Newsletter issues become Announcements and Deliveries (a sent issue keeps dates, counts, approver and archive address; running the command twice changes nothing).
- Gherkin: Fan-out counts.
- Gherkin: No text in the catalog (old RENDER attribute not carried).
- Shipped and Distinctive Mark do not break.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.

**Always-on agent standard (2026-11-16; design `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md`)**
The roundup's schedule becomes a schedule trigger from list data (PPY-2a53cd, PPY-4d74d9); its once-only key uses the list's local period (PPY-b71153); an empty period sends nothing (PPY-1d451f). The conversion of sent issues carries consent evidence and suppression unchanged and checks counts before sends resume. Now also blocked by PPY-2a53cd, PPY-4d74d9 and PPY-b71153.
